description: Background plugin that shows a map-anchored card when a feature is clicked, for layers that opt in. No UI panel.

descriptionFull.title: Shows a popup card when a feature is clicked, for any layer with Show Feature Popup switched on in its Interface settings. The card lists the layer's configured properties and can offer up to two actions, each emitting an event other plugins act on. Requires the deck.gl map engine; on Leaflet the plugin stays inactive, since MMGIS opens features there through its own click path. A vector tile layer whose features carry differing property sets may show 0 for a property a given feature lacks. A tile layer with Pick Value On Click switched on answers a click with the value at that point as a feature carrying value, location (the clicked point as 'lat, lng'), asOf, band and item, listed the same way; while that value is being fetched, a card reading 'Reading value…' holds the spot, and a spot with no value says so.

variables.featurePopup.enabled: (bool) required; the opt-in. A block without it is ignored
variables.featurePopup.title: (str) heading template; text as written, with every '{prop}' replaced by that property's value. Falls back to the layer's useKeyAsName
variables.featurePopup.properties: (arr) property keys to list, in order, dot notation for nested ones; omit to list every property
variables.featurePopup.actions: (arr) up to two { label, event } pairs. A bare event is emitted as plugin:feature-popup:<event>; one carrying a namespace is emitted as written. Payload: { feature, layerId, latlng }

name: FeaturePopup
